sql: SELECT TOP 10 az.UserName AS userName, po.StoreCode AS storeCode, MIN(u.UserId) AS userId, MIN(r.Name) AS portalRole, MIN(cu.Role) AS role FROM dbo.ZnodeUser u INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers a ON a.Id = u.AspNetUserId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser az ON az.AspNetZnodeUserId = a.UserName INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUserRoles ur ON ur.UserId = a.Id INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetRoles r ON r.Id = ur.RoleId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store LEFT JOIN cso.TblCustom_UserManagement cu ON cu.UserName = az.UserName AND cu.StoreCode = po.StoreCode WHERE (a.LockoutEnd IS NULL OR a.LockoutEnd < @now) AND r.IsActive = @activeFlag AND ((r.Name = @portalRole AND ur.PortalId = po.PortalId AND u.IsActive = @activeFlag AND EXISTS (SELECT up.UserId FROM dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up WHERE up.UserId = u.UserId AND up.PortalId = po.PortalId)) OR ((r.Name = @allStoresAdminRole OR r.Name = @allStoresSuperAdminRole) AND ur.PortalId IS NULL)) AND (@role IS NULL OR cu.Role = @role) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR az.UserName = @preferred) GROUP BY az.UserName, po.StoreCode ORDER BY az.UserName
